page_title: Νεόδμητη Κατοικία στο Περιστέρι | Ευγειος Goodland ΕΠΕ
heading: ΑΛΚΑΜΕΝΟΥΣ 4, ΠΕΡΙΣΤΕΡΙ
description_el: Πενταώροφη πολυκατοικία επί pilotis με υπόγειο.

lots.text_el: Αποτελείται από 1 υπνοδωμάτιο, καθιστικό, κουζίνα, τραπεζαρία και μπάνιο. Διαθέτει θέση πάρκινγκ στο ισόγειο, αποθήκη στο υπόγειο, laminate πατώματα, θερμομονωτικά κουφώματα, σίτες, ενεργειακούς υαλοπίνακες, κέλυφος εξωτερικής θερμομόνωσης, παροχή για φορτιστή ηλεκτρικού οχήματος. Υπάρχει αναμονή για ηλιακό θερμοσίφωνα & για a/c για ψύξη. H θέρμανση πραγματοποιείται μέσω λέβητα και σωμάτων.
lots.text_en: It consists of 1 bedroom, a living room, a kitchen-dining room, and a bathroom. It has a parking space on the ground floor, a storage room in the basement, laminate floors, thermally insulated frames, screens, energy-efficient glazing, external thermal insulation shell, power supply for an electric vehicle charger. There is a standby for a solar water heater & for a/c for cooling. Heating is via a boiler and radiators.

notes: Unavailable marker on this page reads '## Μη διαθέσιμο   (not available)' (lowercase 'not', multiple spaces). WebFetch caps verbatim quotes at about 125 characters. The full paragraphs for lots 1 to 5 were obtained as consecutive fragments that I concatenated (please spot-check them against the live page). For lots 6 to 11 the tool refused to give verbatim text, so text_el/text_en are null and must be copied from the Wix editor or page source. Facts known from summaries: lot 6 (3rd floor, 52 m2) has underground parking and a basement storage room. Lot 7 (3rd floor, 70 m2) has underground parking. Lot 8 (3rd floor, 52 m2) has parking on the ground floor (pilotis). Maisonette 105 m2 has 'δύο μπάνια και wc' and ground-floor (pilotis) parking. Maisonette 99 m2 has 'δύο μπάνια και wc' and underground parking. Maisonette 107 m2 has 'δύο μπάνια' and underground parking. All units share the same features: laminate floors, insulated frames, screens, energy-efficient glazing, external insulation, an EV charger supply, solar and A/C standby, and boiler with radiators. The Greek paragraphs on this page say 'τραπεζαρία' where the English says 'kitchen-dining room'. The Greek 'μπάνιo' in lot 4 and the 'H' in 'H θέρμανση' may be Latin characters on the source page; I kept them as returned. Maisonette images: in the Wix markdown, the 4th-5th floor slideshow images appear AFTER each price heading, in this positional order: [after 105's price] 1α (4), 1α (3), δ1, ε1, δ2; [after 99's price] ε2, δ3; [after 107's price] ε3. I regrouped them by filename (δ = 4th floor, ε = 5th floor, digit = maisonette number), so δ2 is assigned to the 99 m2 unit and δ3 to the 107 m2 unit. The two 1α png images in the 105 m2 block have different media ids from the gallery images with the same alt text. The building images (4.jpg, 1.jpg) are reused in the gallery.
